title: The Episode About Baba Banda And Bahadur Shah S

blocks.text: The emperor’s message names routes, meeting possibilities, and movement toward Lahore, but Banda treats the overture as a snare rather than a trustworthy peace proposal.
After the answer returns, the emperor still pauses, while the Turks regain brief hope and Banda strengthens himself in the hills and around fortified points before the imperial side advances again.
Lahore thus appears here as both destination and symbol of the political zone that neither side can ignore.
